module: Fast wrapper (FFI) around the engine's debug drawing (BNG_DBG_DRAW_*). In the GE the calls are made in onPreRender(), on the vehicle side in onDebugDraw(). Loaded with require('utils/debugDraw'). Colors are 'packed' integers (see the global color() in utils.lua) and not ColorF/ColorI. The fields M.Sphere, M.Line, etc. are the raw FFI functions (separate x,y,z coordinates); the M.drawXxx accept vec3.
usage:
local dd = require('utils/debugDraw')
dd.drawSphere(vec3(0,0,1), 0.5, color(255,0,0,255))
dd.drawTextAdvanced(vec3(0,0,2), 'hello')
notes: If ffi is absent, a log E is emitted and all fields are nop (empty function).

Bug: drawTextAdvanced uses the variable `defaultTextColBg` (never defined; the local constant is named DEFAULTTEXTCOLBG): bgColorPacked is therefore nil by default instead of the intended translucent gray.
The generation tool flags the fields M.Cylinder, M.Line, etc. as 'ffifound undefined': this is a false positive of the analysis, ffifound is properly defined locally (pcall(require,'ffi')).
The fields Cylinder, Line, Text, LineInstance_MinArgBatch and TriSolidBatch have no vec3 wrapper; they must be called with separate coordinates (engine C signature, not visible in this file).

Sphere.desc: BNG_DBG_DRAW_Sphere(x, y, z, r, packedCol, useZ), raw FFI.

Cylinder.desc: BNG_DBG_DRAW_Cylinder, raw FFI (signature not visible here).

Line.desc: BNG_DBG_DRAW_Line, raw FFI (signature not visible here).

Text.desc: BNG_DBG_DRAW_Text, raw FFI (signature not visible here).

drawSphere.desc: Draws a debug sphere. The only difference from debugDrawer: the color is a packed integer.

drawLineInstance_MinArg.desc: Draws a line (instanced version, minimal arguments).

drawSquarePrism.desc: Draws a square/rectangular-base prism between two points.

drawTextAdvanced.desc: Draws text at a 3D or 2D position. Default values: white text, useAdvancedText=false, twod=false, shadow=false, useZ=true.

bgColorPacked.desc: Background color (see notes: bug, nil by default)
